# gi.io_utils.detect_encoding { #bedrock_ge.gi.io_utils.detect_encoding }

```python
gi.io_utils.detect_encoding(source)
```

Detect the character encoding of various input types.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| source | str \| Path \| IO\[str\] \| IO\[bytes\] \| bytes | The source to detect encoding from. - str or Path: File path. - IO[str]: Already decoded text stream (returns `DEFAULT_ENCODING`) - IO[bytes]: Binary stream to detect encoding from - bytes: Binary data to detect encoding from | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                             |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | The detected encoding name (e.g., 'utf-8', 'iso-8859-1', 'ascii', etc.) |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type              | Description                       |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------------------------|
|        | TypeError         | If the source type is unsupported |
|        | FileNotFoundError | If a file path doesn't exist      |
